schema: CREATE TABLE course (course_id INT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT); CREATE TABLE teaches (id INT PRIMARY KEY, course_id INT, year INT);
correct_query: SELECT course.course_id, teaches.id FROM course JOIN teaches ON course.course_id = teaches.course_id WHERE teaches.year = 2010
